description: This file defines a React component for the '/notes' route in a Remix application, handling listing, searching, creating, editing, and deleting notes. It also manages server-side data loading and actions related to the notes.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes for the authenticated user, supporting search query parameter 'q'. Handles unauthorized errors by redirecting to login.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles delete requests for notes by note ID, ensuring proper token validation and error handling.

methods.name: Notes
methods.description: React component rendering the notes list, search form, and delete/edit controls.
